background:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE reusable fixed-background plate, landscape16:9, for a 2D parody game battle cinematic. Match the supplied official CANCEL CITY card's dense ugly scratchy black etching, stippling, cheap lurid-print texture and acid-neon contrasts; NO character from reference. 
Scene: empty sci-fi supermarket cold-storage LOADING BAY battlefield. Battered upright refrigerator units and industrial freezer doors stand far in the background around a broad loading-bay entrance; exposed refrigeration pipes above and stacked unbranded crates along the distant walls. Huge cracked concrete floor occupies the lower half with a level continuous combat plane and low perspective. Spacious center and left foreground reserved for a large composited actor; keep objects/background detail distant. Acid green emergency strip rim lighting from the back, deep black and dark magenta shadows, icy faint cyan refrigerator light, limited dirty grey concrete. Detailed scratched ink hatching, abrasions, stippling, grotesque grungy comic print style. Draw perspective consistently with viewing the scene at waist height, no fisheye. Dramatic but readable.
STRICT: completely EMPTY. No human, soldier, armor, creature, cheese, gun, projectile, explosion, smoke, floating particles, text, words, numbers, labels, logos, card frame or watermark. NO giant central prop blocking the actor. This single static backdrop must stay exactly unchanged across all animation poses. Flat artwork matching reference; no clean anime, glossy digital painting, vector art or photorealistic3D.
